credits.title: The Housemaid
credits.overview: Trying to escape her past, Millie Calloway accepts a job as a live-in housemaid for the wealthy Nina and Andrew Winchester. But what begins as a dream job quickly unravels into something far more dangerous—a sexy, seductive game of secrets, scandal, and power.

credits.title: The Quest for Tom Sawyer's Gold
credits.overview: Agatha Armstrong and her trusty sidekick Mrs. Mac were once the world’s most daring adventurers. But when her son Ant came along, everything quickly changed and her devil-may-care ways took a backseat to being over-protective and terrified of anything that posed a risk to her family.

credits.title: Two of Everything
credits.overview: The movie Two of Everything is a subversive thriller which explores the duality between a successful pop star and her body double.

credits.title: No Loss / No Gain
credits.overview: A mysterious modern-day Robin Hood gives the victims of a bank robbery a million dollar opportunity.

credits.title: Lily Is Here
credits.overview: Dallas and heroin have one thing in common: Duncan always goes back to them.

credits.title: Test Pattern
credits.overview: A relationship is put to the test after Renesha is sexually assaulted and her boyfriend Evan drives her from hospital to hospital in search of a rape kit.

credits.title: Mom
credits.overview: A young boy believes he is forced to raise his two younger siblings after tragedy had stricken their family. Fearing they would be separated and never see each other again, like the immigrant children he saw it happen to on the news.

credits.title: Revenge In Kind
credits.overview: Stumped by brutal sex-mutilation crimes, Detective Chris Coxon turns to police psychologist Sarah Scott for help. credits.title: Broken
credits.overview: A tough Dallas divorce attorney struggles to balance her personal and professional life.

credits.title: I Saw the Light
credits.overview: Singer and songwriter Hank Williams rises to fame in the 1940s, but alcohol abuse and infidelity take a toll on his career and marriage to fellow musician Audrey Mae Williams.
